title: Law of excluded middle
summary: For every statement P, classical logic admits P or not-P.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared classical logic context is fixed.

content.plain: For every statement P, classical logic admits P or not-P.
content.exact: The schema P∨¬P is derivable or postulated in classical systems. It is not generally derivable in intuitionistic logic.
content.example: Applied to a proposition about an integer, it permits case analysis into P and ¬P even without a decision procedure.
content.caveat: Logical acceptance is framework-relative; QEVA records the branch instead of calling alternative logics defective.
